# Super Library

Purpose: source-traceable English language retrieval for AI papers, rebuttals,
related work, and technical translation.

Pinned snapshot: v0.1.0 (2026-07-29)

Agent workflow:
1. If this repository is cloned, read AGENTS.md and use scripts/superlib.py.
2. Otherwise, load the self-contained compact context:
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.1.0/dist/super-library-compact.md
3. For broader focused coverage, use the general pack plus exactly one technical
   domain pack instead of the compact context:
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.1.0/dist/packs/general.md
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.1.0/dist/packs/world_models.md
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.1.0/dist/packs/reinforcement_learning.md
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.1.0/dist/packs/embodied_ai.md
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.1.0/dist/packs/robot_learning.md
4. Retrieve rhetoric and technical concepts separately. Preserve facts, numbers,
   negation, modality, citations, and user constraints.
5. Verify primary links before writing definitions or literature claims. The
   corpus is a language and discovery aid, not scientific evidence.
6. If local tools are available, run the limited wording lint. Otherwise manually
   check overclaim, unresolved placeholders, terminology, claim scope, citations,
   and translation fidelity.
7. If no corpus file can be loaded, state that Super Library was not used.

Machine-readable release files:
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.1.0/dist/manifest.json
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.1.0/dist/index.json
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.1.0/dist/stats.json

This snapshot contains paraphrases, field-standard terminology, short
multi-source-attested collocations, and original templates—not paper quotations.
A static snapshot cannot establish what is currently latest or state of the art.
